description: Supplementary review catalogue and scorecard for "Electric Vehicle Charging Data for Flexibility is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tiago Carlos Caló Fonseca, Luis Lino Ferreira (School of Engineering of the Polytechnical Institute of Porto,). These supplementary files accompany the manuscript Electric Vehicle Charging Data for Flexibility Research: A Systematic Review. The archive contains the review protocol, search log, screening record, final catalogue of 30 public electric-vehicle charging dataset releases, 13-criterion flexibility-readiness scorecard, source manifest, reference map, and input data for the illustrative assumption-sensitivity example. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
